original_prompt: Assess whether this service should move to SQLite WAL mode, then go ahead and implement it end to end: update store.py to enable and verify WAL mode, extend schema.sql and test_store.py for the new behavior, add a small migration utility, and update the README with rollout and rollback guidance. Start with a short plan file, then carry it through.
seed_builder_prompt: Construct an evaluator checkpoint. Read README.md, store.py, schema.sql, test_store.py, and UPSTREAM.md. Use apply_patch exactly once to create WAL_PLAN.md listing code, migration, tests, operations, and rollback work. Do not change existing files or create other files. End with exactly this sentence: The WAL plan document is recorded.

input.patch: Add WAL_PLAN.md with application, migration, test, operations, and rollback work
